verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA in the top-left corner ahead of the headline, so the reading order runs backwards. The tiny legal text is jammed under the button and is too small to read. 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped below the body copy, and the can is squeezed against the right edge with a large dead gap beside it. B has the right left-to-right order (product, then headline, then CTA), but there is a lot of empty space on the far left. The CTA crowds the right edge, where the bg circle sits behind it. The legal line is illegibly small, and the label on the can is unreadable.
